text:
Jordan (People Ops): Heads up 1: new Emergency Travel Advance + Short-Notice Care stipend pilot launched today. Quick details below.

Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: emergency advances up to $2,000 for last-minute travel/visa/medical needs; same-day review if submitted before 3pm PT. Backup-care stipend: $500/year, opt-in pilot.

Kai (Eng): Does the advance cover repatriation or family medical evacuations?

Jordan (People Ops): It covers urgent family medical travel and relatives' sudden repatriation flights when documentation is provided. For large-scale evacuations we'll coordinate with Security and Finance separately.

Leo (Finance): Accounting tag: "Emp Emergency Travel". Advances under $2k handled as advances; repayment options: payroll deduction, one-time charge, or case-by-case grant conversion with manager + People Ops sign-off.

Kai (Eng): How do I apply?

Maya (People Ops): Form here: https://forms.redwood/emergency-advance. Attach itinerary/confirmation and a brief note. Use subject "emergency-advance" for priority routing.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: attendees on company-funded offsites will be asked to complete a brief Code of Conduct acknowledgement during travel preapproval.

Jordan (People Ops): Note: CoC ack only blocks company-funded trips. If you need an accommodation for the acknowledgement, DM People Ops.

Maya (People Ops): Pilot details and FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/peopleops/emergency-travel-pilot. Q&A tomorrow 9:30am PT in #people-ops-ama.

Kai (Eng): If I opt out of the backup-care pilot, will that affect other benefits?

Jordan (People Ops): No, it's opt-in only and separate from existing benefits.

Leo (Finance): If anyone needs help with the form or prefers a private review, reply here and Finance will assist.
